body.message:
Please note that we are unable to confirm the rate for each extension in advance, as rates are subject to change depending on market conditions and availability. The rate may remain the same or may increase at the time of your extension.

However, if you are planning to stay longer, please let us know how many months you would like to stay, and we can provide you with a fixed rate for the requested period.

For 3 to 6 months’ bookings, please note that we require the first and last month’s payment in advance to confirm the booking and secure the unit for you.

If you prefer to extend on a month-to-month basis, we are unable to guarantee the rate or availability, as both will depend on the market conditions at the time of each extension.
Thank you for your understanding.
